author: OpenAI Codex delegated evaluation agent
provenance: Fresh agent-authored synthetic tasks; no candidate classifier inspected; no external calls; no production or private prompts.
split_algorithm: Within each tier, number authored groups 1..8; take the two lowest lexical SHA256(gauge-split-v1:<tier>:<number>) digests as heldout; keep both paraphrases together.
limitations: Paraphrases are correlated; 80 tasks represent 40 independent scenario groups.
The small English-only balanced cohort is diagnostic and not representative of production.
Production promotion requires a fresh human-reviewed cohort and separate authorization.
